synopsis: Eiga, the next head of the prestigious Kujo family, is in a serious predicament. That is, love. He wants to approach Himeka, a girl in his class whom he secretly has feelings for, but because it is his first love, he can't think of a good way to do it... At that moment, he decides to ask for advice from Maria, a maid of the same age who serves the Kujo family...!?
chapterSourceTitle: Uchi no Maid ga Class no Suki na Ko ni Nite Iru
